tool_args.rationale: At the target-scale horizons the observed response is approximately 2.52 times current input, with small deviations consistent with a damped transient. Fit an affine current-input and current-state approximation numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow horizon range does not identify its relaxation rate reliably; the observed response is already close to linear in current input.
The available batch has already been acquired and the eight observations support a low-parameter long-horizon approximation.
It is not relevant to identifying the forecast law.
